description: This file defines the ActiveNotificationsActivity class, which manages an Android activity related to active notifications, including registering and handling a broadcast receiver for notification deletions.

classes.name: ActiveNotificationsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays active notifications and handles notification deletion via broadcast receiver.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, finds the fragment, and updates notification count.

methods.name: findFragment
methods.description: Finds and assigns the ActiveNotificationsFragment associated with the activity layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the broadcast receiver to listen for notification delete actions.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver to prevent leaks when activity is paused.
